entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is AutoVoice. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return something I bought. It's a VeloBand Pulse.

Good morning. I understand you want to return a VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly help you with that. Could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's under jane.doe@email.com. And hurry this up, please. I don't have all day.
Thank you, Ms. Doe. I've located your order. I see the VeloBand Pulse purchased 15 days ago. To confirm, you'd like to initiate a return?
Yes! Exactly! It's not what I expected. The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate, and frankly, it's a waste of money. I want my money back.

I understand your frustration, Ms. Doe. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. I can process a full refund for the VeloBand Pulse. You can expect the refund to reflect in your account in 7-10 business days after we receive the returned item. We want you to be happy with your VeloFit product.

Ninety days? Really? Great! I was worried because it's been a little over two weeks. Another company rep tried to tell me it was only 10 days for returns and I was beyond furious! This is much better. So, what do I do now?

I apologize for any misinformation you may have received. To initiate the return, I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Simply repackage the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, if possible, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location. Once we receive the smart watch back, the refund will be processed.
Okay, great. That sounds easy enough. Just send me the label.
The shipping label has been sent to jane.doe@email.com. You'll receive a confirmation email once we process the return. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

No, I think that's it. Thank you so much for your help! You were much more helpful than the last person I spoke to. I appreciate you clarifying the return policy; I'm glad it's 90 days and not only 10 days.
You're very welcome, Ms. Doe. We value your business. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us. Have a great day.
